Trace, implement and test: Check Prime

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
#include<bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

bool isPrime(int N)
{
    if (N <= 1) {
        return false;
    }

    for (int i = 2; i <= sqrt(N); i++) {

        if (N % i == 0) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

int main() {

    int N ;
    cin>>N;

    if (isPrime(N)) {
        printf("Yes\n");
    }
    else {
        printf("No\n");
    }

    return 0;
}
